title: Full Stack AI/ML Developer
description:
We’re Hiring

Full Stack AI/ML Developer

Bridge machine-learning research and production. Integrate models into scalable back-ends, ship the interfaces on top, and deploy the whole thing to the cloud.

* Experience:3+ Years
* Location:Gandhinagar
* Job Type:Full Time

Apply for This Role

**Company Overview**

Meritorious Global is a forward-thinking technology company dedicated to delivering
**cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and scalable digital solutions**
for global clients. Our mission is to create transformative tech that solves real-world problems while fostering a culture of
**innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth**
.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Full Stack AI/ML Developer**
with at least
**3+ years**
of experience who can bridge the gap between machine learning research and production-ready applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy intelligent systems that are scalable, efficient, and impactful. This is an
**onsite, full-time role**
based in our Gandhinagar office.

**You Will Be Responsible For**

* **Model Integration:**
  Work with data scientists to integrate machine learning and deep learning models into scalable back-end architectures.
* **API Development:**
  Build and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs to serve model predictions and data insights.
* **Frontend Engineering:**
  Create responsive and intuitive user interfaces using modern frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular).
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Deploy and manage applications using cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **Data Handling:**
  Develop data pipelines and storage solutions (SQL/NoSQL) to support real-time and batch processing.
* **Optimization & Monitoring:**
  Optimize model performance, ensure scalability, and set up monitoring/logging solutions for AI systems.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists, product managers, designers, and other development members.

**Ideal Profile**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Proven experience (3+ years) as a Full Stack Engineer (front-end & back-end) with AI/ML project experience.
* Strong proficiency in front-end technologies (TypeScript, HTML, JavaScript, React.js or similar).
* Solid back-end knowledge (Node.js, Python, Java, or similar).
* Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), etc.
* Stay at the forefront of LLM capabilities, prompt engineering, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of multimodal AI systems (text, image, audio).
* Experience with AI frameworks/libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for deploying AI applications.
* Skilled with database management systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools.
* Understanding of software development best practices, including version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with diverse teams.
* Excellent professional written and verbal English communication skills.
* Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Passionate, career-driven, and focused on long-term growth.
